text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For this year's summer training camp, we 
had prepared a certain secret plan aimed 
toward the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, what are we doing at this training 
camp?
choice_data_list: I think I'll try to master speed.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Speed? Not the pool?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah. I mean, it's the ocean, so of course 
there's no pool. Guess it can't be helped 
then.
choice_data_list: And I've arranged a teacher for you.
And I've arranged a teacher for you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Sensei?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Gooood morning! Jordan-san, let's head out 
for morning training!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(She is Sakura Bakushin O. An Umamusume 
who has made a name for herself as a 
sprinter.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's 4 AM. That's way too early... 
Besides, you look sleepy too, Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, are we seriously doing this the whole 
camp? Waking up this early...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Tosen Jordan is aiming for in this 
Tenno Sho (Autumn) is to become faster 
than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then I want to focus on training speed. 
Though how you use your legs differs 
between sprints and middle distance..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Speed isn't built in a day! If you want 
to master speed, it's important to act 
quickly yourself!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Here we go! Bakushin, bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (RUUUUMBLE!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...So fast...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Sakura Bakushin O's speed seemed 
dazzling to them right now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wh-what, Bakushin, Bakushiiin...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Jordan-san, your voice is too quiet! 
Bakushin, bakushiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hah!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice Bakushin cheer, Trainer-san! 
What about you, Jordan-san...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Bakushin Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... Whew~... Wait up, 
Jordan-saaaan...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, why are YOU the one worn out!? We've 
barely even started running!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I-I shouted while running, so I'm extra... 
tiiired...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our ultra-early-morning routine... 
or rather, our summer training camp began.
